name: Custom 3D Relief Metal Coin
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality metal, offering a solid, durable, and premium feel.
    - Features a 3D relief effect with raised details, creating a striking and sophisticated appearance.
    - Thickness: 3mm ~ 0.11 in, giving the coin a sturdy weight and collectible-quality finish.
    - Smooth edges and finely detailed surface enhance both visual appeal and tactile experience.
    - Comes with an acrylic display case for better protection, storage, and presentation.
    - Available in 3 elegant color finishes: Gold, Silver, and Rose Gold.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size: 4 x 4 cm ~ 1.57 x 1.57 in.
    📌 Note: The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customize the printed design only.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for sharp details and vibrant colors.
    - Double-sided design with high-definition artwork on both front and back.
    - The 3D embossed effect creates depth and highlights fine design elements with a premium commemorative look.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Ideal as a collectible commemorative coin or keepsake item.
    - Can be displayed in the included acrylic case for protection and presentation.
    - Suitable for desk display, collections, or personal memorabilia.
    - Compact size makes it easy to carry or showcase anywhere.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful gift for collectors, veterans, history enthusiasts, or loved ones.
    - Perfect for anniversaries, commemorations, birthdays, or special events.
    - Combines symbolic value with premium craftsmanship, making it a timeless keepsake.🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Custom 3D Relief Metal Coin

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
